WITH om AS (
  SELECT "Timestamp" AS hr,

),
st AS (
  SELECT "Timestamp", "Altitude (km)", LEAD("Altitude (km)") OVER (ORDER BY "Timestamp") AS nxt
  FROM wu001_to_wu715_initial_states
),
tgt AS (
  SELECT "Timestamp" AS iv, (nxt - "Altitude (km)") / 72.0 AS y FROM st
),
means AS (
  SELECT iv, var, AVG(val) AS xbar
  FROM om
  WHERE hr < TIMESTAMP '2018-10-10 00:00:00'
  GROUP BY 1, 2
  UNION ALL
  SELECT CASE WHEN "source_file" LIKE '%to_20181004%' THEN TIMESTAMP '2018-10-01 00:00:00'
              WHEN "source_file" LIKE '%to_20181007%' THEN TIMESTAMP '2018-10-04 00:00:00'
              WHEN "source_file" LIKE '%to_20181010%' THEN TIMESTAMP '2018-10-07 00:00:00' END AS iv,
         'Sat_Density' AS var,
         AVG("Orbit Mean Density (kg/m^3)") AS xbar
  FROM "Sat_Density"
  WHERE "Timestamp" >= TIMESTAMP '2018-10-01 00:00:00' AND "Timestamp" < TIMESTAMP '2018-10-11 00:00:00'
    AND "Orbit Mean Density (kg/m^3)" <= 1e30
  GROUP BY 1, 2
),
pairs AS (
  SELECT m.var, t.y, m.xbar
  FROM means m JOIN tgt t ON m.iv = t.iv
  WHERE m.iv IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT var, corr(y, xbar) AS pearson_r, COUNT(*) AS n
FROM pairs
GROUP BY var
ORDER BY abs(pearson_r) DESC
